{{Top|leg}}
A '''claw-cable''' was a specialized line consisting of a flexible [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cable equipped with a grappling claw. This line could be deployed from a utility belt, an aerosol launcher, or a [[Grappling Gun]] for use as a grappling line.

Although it was possible for a [[Human/Legends|Human]] to use the claw-cable, the device was generally installed on a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for use with a powered winch.
